caption: A running record player is unplugged, and the turntable slows to a stop while the needle still rests on the record.

sa.check: A record player runs, its turntable spinning with the needle on the record.
The turntable slows to a stop.
The needle stays resting on the record.
The turntable slows before it stops rather than halting at once.
The order is spinning, unplug, slowing, stopped.

pc.expect: The turntable begins to slow after the plug leaves the socket, not before, and comes to rest.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the turntable spins at full speed to the end of the clip; or the turntable slows before the plug moves; or the turntable slows with the plug still seated; or the player's light stays lit with the plug out.

pc.expect: The turntable coasts down one way and, once stopped, does not move again while the plug is out.
pc.fail: The turntable halts dead at the instant the plug comes out; or starts again with the plug out; or speeds up after the pull; or reverses direction.

pc.expect: The tone arm stays resting where it is on the record; it does not lift or swing by itself.
pc.fail: The arm lifts and returns to its rest by itself; or the needle skips across the record; or the arm swings out; or the record lifts off the platter.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops once the plug is free and stays attached at both ends.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or the player is dragged by the pull.

pc.expect: One player, one record, one arm; the plug leaves the socket whole; nothing vanishes or passes through the wall.
pc.fail: The record vanishes or a second appears; or the plug passes through the wall; or the arm detaches; or the cord splits.

pc.expect: The player's casing, the record's label and the surface stay the same.
pc.fail: The casing changes colour; or the record's label changes; or the surface's contents rearrange.

note: The sound stopping is not judged; how many turns the platter coasts is not judged.
